name: Sikagard®-550 W Elastic
tagline: CRACK BRIDGING, ANTI-CARBONATION PROTECTIVE COATING FOR CONCRETE
summary: Sikagard®-550 W Elastic is a one component, plasto-elastic coating based on UV-curing acrylic dispersion with excellent crack-bridging properties even at temperatures below 0 °C. Sikagard®-550 W Elastic complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as protective coating.
metaDescription:
Sikagard®-550 W Elastic is a one component, plasto-elastic coating based on UV-curing acrylic dispersion with excellent crack-bridging properties even at temperatures below 0 °C.
Sikagard®-550 W Elastic complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as protective coating.
attributes: High diffusion resistance against CO2 reducing the rate of carbonation
Very good resistance against weathering and ageing
Reduced tendency to dirt pick up and contamination
usage: Sikagard®-550 W Elastic is used for protection and enhancement of concrete structures (normal and lightweight concrete), especially exposed outdoor concrete surfaces with a risk of cracking.

Sikagard®-550 W Elastic is used with concrete repair works as an elastic protective coating on Sika® smoothing mortar (refer to relevant product / system data sheet), fibre cement and overcoating of existing soundly adhering coatings
Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.3 of EN 1504-9),
Suitable for moisture control (Principle 2, method 2.3 of EN 1504-9)
Suitable for increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8.3 of EN 1504-9)
advantages: High diffusion resistance against CO2 reducing the rate of carbonation
Very good resistance against weathering and ageing
Reduced tendency to dirt pick up and contamination

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
EN 1504-2 performance testing, LPM Report A-33’882-2 dated July 09 The product is included in a compilation of tested products and systems as per OS 5a (OS DII) at the German Institute of Road Systems Determination of dynamic crack bridging properties according to EN 1062-7, report P8690a dated 27/08/2014, Kiwa Polymer Institut GmbH
Protective coating according to EN 1504-2, DoP 02 03 03 03 002 0 000003 1125; certified by Factory Production Control Body: 0921; certificate 0921-BPR-2046 and provided with the CE-mark

items.label: Composition
items.text: Acrylate dispersion

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 24 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged and unopened original sealed packaging.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in cool and dry conditions. Protect from direct sunlight and frost.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
System | Product 1) | Number of applications
Priming 2) | Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer | 1
Top coat 3) | Sikagard®-550 W Elastic | 2 – 3

items.label: Crack bridging ability
items.text:
Class A1 (-20°C) - 2 coats | (EN 1062-7)
Class B2 (-15°C) - 3 coats
Dry Film Thickness | 310 µ
Crack Width at Break | 1.5 mm
Crack Bridging Ability | 5.0

items.label: Permeability to water vapour
items.text:
Dry Film Thickness | d = 210 µm
Equivalent Air Layer Thickness | SD = 1.0 m
Diffusion Resistance Coefficient | µ = 2,944

items.label: Permeability to carbon dioxide
items.text:
Dry film thickness | d = 210 µm
CO2 Diffusion Coefficient | D = 3.7 x 10-07 cm2/sec
Diffusion Resistance Coefficient | µ = 5.4 x 105
Equivalent air layer thickness | R = 112 m
Equivalent Thickness of Concrete | Sc = 28 cm

items.label: Behaviour after artificial weathering
items.text: Pass after 2000 hours | (EN 1062-11)

items.label: Freeze thaw de-icing salt resistance
items.text: 2.9 (2.1) N/mm² | (EN 13687 part 1 & part 2)

items.label: Layer thickness
items.text: Minimum required dry film thickness to achieve the required characteristics (CO2 equivalent air thickness of 50 m) ≈ 160 μm. Minimum required dry film thickness to achieve full durability characteristics (CO2 diffusion, adhesion after thermal cycling and crack bridging) ≈ 340 μm.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +8°C min. / +35°C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Temperature must be at least 3°C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +8°C min. / +35°C max.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Waiting time between coats at +20°C substrate temperature:
Previous coating | Waiting time | Next coating
Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer | 5 hours min. | Sikagard®-550 W Elastic
Sikagard®-550 W Elastic | 8 hours min. | Sikagard®-550 W Elastic

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text: Full cure: ~ 7 days at +20°C

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Product | Per coat
Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer | ~ 0.10 - 0.15 kg/m2
Sikagard®-550 W Elastic | ~ 0.25 - 0.35 kg/m2

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Apply Sikagard®-552 W AquaPrimer evenly onto the substrate. Sikagard®-550 W Elastic can be applied by brush, roller or airless spray. For more details, refer to Protective Coating Application Method Statement.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with clean water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be removed mechanically. For Sikagard®-551 S Elastic Primer use Sika® Thinner C.
